questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{根据有效性的定义有} & D(\widehat{\mu}) = \alpha^2 + \beta^2 = \alpha^2 + (1-\alpha)^2 \triangleq d(\alpha), \\& \text{要使方差最小，即求方差函数} d(\alpha) \text{的最小值，求} d(\alpha) \text{关于} \alpha \text{求导数，并另其为零，有} & 2\alpha - 2(1-\alpha) = 0 \Rightarrow \alpha = \frac{1}{2}. \\& \frac{d^2(\alpha)}{d\alpha^2}\bigg|_{\alpha = \frac{1}{2}} = 2 > 0, \text{故} \alpha = \frac{1}{2} \text{是} d(\alpha) \text{的最小值，此时} d(\alpha) = (\frac{1}{2})^2 + (1-\frac{1}{2})^2 = \frac{1}{2}. \end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}E(Z)&=aE(S_1^2)+bE(S_2^2)=\sigma^2,\text{即}Z\text{是}\sigma^2\text{的无偏估计。因}S_1^2、S_2^2\text{相互独立，所以}\\D(Z)&=D(aS_1^2+bS_2^2)=(a^2(n_1-1)+b^2(n_2-1))\cdot 2\sigma^2=(a^2(n_1-1)+(1-a)^2(n_2-1))\cdot 2\sigma^4,\\&\text{令}\frac{dD(Z)}{da}=2\sigma^4\left[\frac{2a}{n_1-1}-\frac{2(1-a)}{n_2-1}\right]=0,\text{得驻点}a=\frac{n_1-1}{n_1+n_2-2}.\\&\text{又}\frac{d^2D(Z)}{da^2}=2\sigma^4\left(\frac{2}{n_1-1}+\frac{2}{n_2-1}\right)>0,\text{知该点为极小值点，所以当}a=\frac{n_1-1}{n_1+n_2-2},\\&b=\frac{n_2-1}{n_1+n_2-2}\text{时，统计量}Z=\frac{1}{n_1+n_2-2}[(n_1-1)S_1^2+(n_2-1)S_2^2]\text{具有最小方差}.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{因为}E(X_{i})=\theta(i=1,2,\cdots,k),\ \text{故}E(\widehat{\theta})=E\bigg(\sum_{i=1}^{\frac{k}{2}}a_{i}X_{i}\bigg)=\sum_{i=1}^{k}a_{i}E(X_{i})=\theta\sum_{i=1}^{\frac{k}{2}}a_{i},\\&\text{欲使}E(\widehat{\theta})=\theta,\ \text{则要}\sum_{i=1}^{\frac{k}{2}}a_{i}=1.\\&\text{因此，当}\sum_{i=1}^{\frac{k}{2}}a_{i}=1\text{时，}\ \widehat{\theta}=\sum_{i=1}^{k}a_{i}X_{i}\text{为}\theta\text{的无偏估计，}D(\widehat{\theta})=\sum_{i=1}^{\frac{k}{2}}a_{i}^{2}\sigma_{i}^{2},\ \text{要在}\sum_{i=1}^{\frac{k}{2}}a_{i}=1\text{的条件下}D(\widehat{\theta})\text{最小，采用拉格朗日乘数法。}\\&\text{令}L(a_{1},a_{2},\cdots,a_{k})=D(\widehat{\theta})+\lambda\bigg(1-\sum_{i=1}^{\frac{k}{2}}a_{i}\bigg)=\sum_{i=1}^{\frac{k}{2}}a_{i}^{2}\sigma_{i}^{2}+\lambda\bigg(1-\sum_{i=1}^{\frac{k}{2}}a_{i}\bigg),\\&\{\begin{array}{l}\dfrac{\partial L}{\partial a_{i}}=0,\ i=1,2,\cdots,k\\ \qquad\qquad\qquad\qquad\text{即}2a_{i}\sigma_{i}^{2}-\lambda=0,\ a_{i}=\dfrac{\lambda}{2_{i}^{2}};\\ \qquad\qquad\qquad\qquad\sum_{i=1}^{k}a_{i}=1,\end{array}\\&\text{又因}\sum_{i=1}^{\frac{k}{2}}a_{i}=1,\ \text{所以}\lambda\sum_{i=1}^{\frac{k}{2}}\dfrac{1}{2\sigma_{i}^{2}}=1,\ \text{记}\sum_{i=1}^{\frac{k}{2}}\dfrac{1}{\sigma_{i}^{2}}=\dfrac{1}{\sigma_{0}^{2}},\ \text{所以}\lambda=2\sigma_{0}^{2},\ \text{于是}a_{i}=\dfrac{\sigma_{0}^{2}}{\sigma_{i}^{2}}\ (i=1,2,\cdots,k),\\&\text{故当}a_{i}=\dfrac{\sigma_{0}^{2}}{\sigma_{i}^{2}}(i=1,2,\cdots,k)\text{时，}\ \widehat{\theta}=\sum_{i=1}^{\frac{k}{2}}a_{i}X_{i}\text{是}\theta\text{的无偏估计，且方差最小。}\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}(1)\theta&=E(X),E(X_i)=E(X)=\theta,D(X)=\theta^2=D(X_i),i=1,2,3,4.\\&E(T_1)=E\bigg(\frac{1}{6}(X_1+X_2)+\frac{1}{3}(X_3+X_4)\bigg)=\bigg(\frac{2}{6}+\frac{2}{3}\bigg)\theta=\theta,\\&E(T_2)=\frac{1}{5}E(X_1+2X_2+3X_3+4X_4)=\frac{1}{5}(1+2+3+4)\theta=2\theta,\\&E(T_3)=\frac{1}{4}E(X_1+X_2+X_3+X_4)=\theta,\text{因此，}T_1,T_3\text{是}\theta\text{的无偏估计量.}2)\ D(T_i)&=\frac{2}{36}\theta^2+\frac{2}{9}\theta^2=\frac{10}{36}\theta^2,\ D(T_3)=\frac{1}{16}\cdot4\theta^2=\frac{4}{36}\theta^2,\end{aligned}
